A Fantastic Dinner at Cims, Worth Every Penny 🍴🥩🍝
Aug 2025 • Couples
We had dinner at Cims on 25/8/2025 and it turned out to be one of those evenings you don’t forget. On the way in we were greeted by a very friendly gentleman, only to find out later he was actually the owner. That small detail already gave the place a really personal and welcoming feel.

The restaurant itself has a lovely atmosphere and for the quality of food, the price is more than fair. Our bill came to about $80 for one starter and two main courses, which is excellent value in my opinion.

As for the food, it was superb. I had the 400g Black Angus steak 🥩 and honestly enjoyed every bite, perfectly cooked and full of flavour. My wife went for the spaghetti Bolognese 🍝 which was rich and delicious. But what really stood out for me was the carpaccio. I’ve travelled quite a bit, including Italy 🇮🇹, and I never thought I’d say this but the carpaccio here was even better.

All in all, Cims delivered on every front with great food, fair pricing, and a genuine personal touch from the people who run it. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a memorable dinner. 🌟
